name: United Club℠ Infinite Card

otherLounges: Star Alliance partner lounges when flying United or Star Alliance partner
loungeAccess.notes: Full United Club membership included (worth $650+/year standalone). Includes cardholder + up to 2 guests or immediate family (spouse/domestic partner + children under 21) at no additional cost.

tripDelay.notes: Delay must be 12+ hours or require overnight stay. Up to $500 per ticket.

tripCancellation.notes: Up to $10,000 per person and $20,000 per trip for prepaid, non-refundable expenses.

lostBaggage.notes: Up to $3,000 per passenger. High-value items sub-limit $500.

baggageDelay.notes: Up to $100/day for 5 days when bags are delayed 6+ hours. Maximum $500.

travelAccidentInsurance.notes: Up to $500,000 accidental death and dismemberment on common carriers.

emergencyMedical.notes: Travel and Emergency Assistance Services: 24/7 referrals for medical, legal, and emergency needs. Cardholder typically responsible for actual medical costs.

rentalCarInsurance.notes: Primary auto rental CDW. Covers up to actual cash value of vehicle.

purchaseProtection.notes: Covers new purchases for 120 days — up to $10,000 per claim.

extendedWarranty.notes: Extends the U.S. manufacturer's warranty by 1 additional year on eligible warranties of 3 years or less.

rewards.diningRate: 2x miles at restaurants including eligible delivery

freeCheckedBags.notes: First and second checked bags free for cardholder and one companion on the same reservation. Saves up to $70 per person each way.

priorityBoarding.notes: Board in Group 1 — earliest group after elite members.

unitedClubMembership.notes: Full United Club membership included (access for cardholder + immediate family or 2 guests). Standalone membership costs $650+/year.

upgradeEligibility.notes: Premier Access: priority check-in, security, boarding, and baggage handling.

eliteStatusBenefits.pqpBonus: 1,000 PQPs per $15,000 in purchases per calendar year, up to 4,000 PQPs annually.
eliteStatusBenefits.notes: Accelerated Premier status earning. PQP thresholds: Silver=4K, Gold=8K, Platinum=12K, 1K=24K.

travelPerks: Full United Club membership (45+ locations + Star Alliance partners)
Unlimited guest access (immediate family or 2 guests)
First and second checked bags free (cardholder + 1 companion)
Group 1 priority boarding on United flights
Premier Access (priority check-in, security, boarding, baggage)
$100 Global Entry / TSA PreCheck / NEXUS credit every 4 years
1,000 PQPs per $15,000 spend (up to 4,000/year) toward Premier status
bestFor: Frequent United travelers who want full United Club lounge membership and maximum miles on United spending
